mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is your daily dish. It is a blistering 91 degrees at Verona Community Park, feeling like a sticky 96, so try not to melt out there. In city news, Mayor Diaz signed the Monarch Pledge, committing Verona to plant pollinator gardens on public properties. Also, Dane County is offering a solar group buy program to make solar energy cheaper and easier for homeowners. In police news, K9 Drea was the star of the week, successfully sniffing out drugs during two separate traffic stops. Stay cool, and grab today's Flavor of the Day, Chocolate Covered Strawberry, at Culver's.
